notes: Summary: Stratus Vector Vault — enterprise search provider for financial services and media conglomerates. Large existing vector store (on-prem) under consideration for migration to Redwood Dedicated/Private.
Scale targets: baseline index size 600M vectors (512-d), projected growth to 1.2B in 18 months; daily ingest ~8–12M vectors, weekly batch exports ~50M.
Latency/throughput: target tail-latency (p99) <100ms for top-50, median <30ms for top-10; throughput target 2k qps for peak queries on business hours.
Reranking flow: dense ANN for recall -> candidate pool 500-10k -> cross-encoder rerank for final top-10. Want Redwood support for two-stage rerank with on-the-fly batching of cross-encoder.
Cost targets: aim for $0.0005–$0.002 per end-to-end query (including embedding lookup + cross-encoder rerank). Extremely cost sensitive at scale.
Technical preferences: 8-bit / 4-bit quantized emb model support, GPU-accelerated FAISS-like ANN, prefix/KV caching for common queries, adaptive batching to preserve latency SLOs.
Data residency & security: EU customer data residency required for EU accounts; must support SSO/SAML, KMS-integrated key management, audit logs retained 2+ years.
Deployment interest: leaning toward Redwood Dedicated with Private control plane in EU region; open to hybrid (on-prem gateway + Redwood managed backplane).
POC scope requested: ingest 600M sample (anonymized) + run 2-week traffic replay; measure p99 latency, end-to-end cost, rerank recall/precision on internal eval sets.
Quote from CTO: "We need sub-50ms for conversational retrieval paths or business UX will suffer; cost at scale is non-negotiable."
Infra notes: will provide parquet exports (~2.5TB compressed) for vector ingest; require advice on sharding strategy, quantization profile recommendations.
Procurement: legal needs data-processing addendum + EU data-residency clause; procurement approval estimated 3–6 weeks after POC if metrics met.
Previous vendors: current pilot with in-house FAISS + Kubernetes; evaluated Pinecone and Milvus — main gaps were cost per q and rerank integration.
Internal stakeholders: CTO (Anna Kline), Head of Search (Derek Osei), Platform Lead (Nadia Fischer), Security (Head: Marco Silveira).
Requested deliverables: POC SOW, sample infra sizing, preliminary cost model (per 100M vectors), canary rollout plan for migration.
